request: My customers keep asking about cloth sizes and I want to train staff, so a mint quiz with one question at a time, four answer buttons and a score at the end is what I need. Add questions through the form.
program:
app "Quiz" star mint
table question q text, a text, b text, c text, d text, right pick A|B|C|D
state qi num = 0
state score num = 0
let total = count(question)
if qi < total
  "Question" qi + 1 "of" total faint
  each question sort at as x
    if index = qi
      stack gap 1
        x.q head
        button x.a large tap set score = score + if(x.right = A, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
        button x.b large tap set score = score + if(x.right = B, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
        button x.c large tap set score = score + if(x.right = C, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
        button x.d large tap set score = score + if(x.right = D, 1, 0) then set qi = qi + 1
else
  "Your score" score "of" total big
  button "Play again" tap set qi = 0 then set score = 0
form question, "Add question"

request: A Next service at line shows the km and date due. It turns to a warning within 500 km. An Update odometer button and a form sit with the list of past services.

app "Car service" car slate
table service done_on date = today, odometer num 0.., cost money, garage text
setting every_km num = 5000 "Service every (km)"

request: is there a way to see wedding spend against each budget
program:
app "Wedding Budget" gift ocean
table func name text, budget money
table expense func ref func, vendor text, amount money
table guest name text, side pick Bride|Groom, count num 1..20 = 1

        it.amount

each guest by side
  stack card
    it.key sum(it.count) bold
    each it
      it.name
form guest, "Add guest"

app "Intervals" bolt ink
setting work dur = 40s
setting rest dur = 20s
state left dur = 40s
state going bool = no
state working bool = yes
state rounds num = 0
every 1s if going set left = left - 1s
when going and left <= 0s set rounds = rounds + if(working, 0, 1) then set left = if(working, rest, work) then set working = not working
stack align center card pad 3 fill if(working, accent, good)
  if(working, "WORK", "REST") head
  left big
  "Round" rounds + 1 faint
row gap 1
  button if(going, "Pause", "Start") tap set going = not going
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set left = work then set working = yes then set rounds = 0

request: Each category like rent, groceries or school shows spent against its own limit with a bar that turns red when over, plus arrows to move between months and a form for each expense.
program:
app "Household" home mint
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Groceries|School|Transport|Medicine|Eid_savings, note text?
setting lim_rent money = 45000 "Rent limit"
setting lim_groceries money = 20000 "Groceries limit"
setting lim_school money = 10000 "School limit"

setting lim_medicine money = 3000 "Medicine limit"
setting lim_eid money = 5000 "Eid savings limit"
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Spent this month" sum(expense.amount month of m) big
each options expense.category as k

    row
      k bold grow color if(spent > lim, bad, ink)
      spent "of" lim
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / lim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > lim, bad, accent) radius 2
form expense
list expense month of m by day

request: The screen says X wins or O wins as soon as the game ends, says Draw when all nine squares are taken, and otherwise shows whose turn it is on a grid of three columns.
program:
app "Tic tac toe" board mint
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: Start with the list of parts sorted by quantity, then the running low count at the top, with a kind of Big, Small or Spare and an expiry date for each.

app "Spare parts" tool ocean
table part name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Big|Small|Spare, expires date?

let short = count(part, it.qty <= it.low)
short "parts running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each part where has(name, q) sort qty as i

      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)

    i.qty bold

form part
remind "Check your parts" at 9:00 on sat

app "Club accounts Buddy" users slate
table member name text
table fee member ref member, amount money
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Events|Supplies|Utilities|Other = Other
let income = sum(fee.amount)
let spent = sum(expense.amount)
screen sheet "Balance" chart
  stat income, "fees received"
  stat spent, "expenses"
  "Balance" income - spent big color if(income < spent, bad, good)
  "This month: in" sum(fee.amount month) ", out" sum(expense.amount month) faint
  each member sort name as m
    row card
      m.name grow
      sum(m.fee.amount year) "this year"
screen entry "Add" plus
  form fee, "Add fee"
  form expense, "Add expense"
  form member, "Add member"
screen yearly "Year" calendar
  "Yearly summary" head
  share expense year by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
  stat sum(fee.amount year), "fees this year"
  stat sum(expense.amount year), "expenses this year"
  "Net for the year" sum(fee.amount year) - sum(expense.amount year) big
  daybars last 7 days, sum(fee.amount on it) - sum(expense.amount on it)

request: A quick ocean app for my habits. The list of habits to tick comes first, then the progress bar with done out of total, and All done today when everything is checked.
program:
app "Habits" check ocean
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

request: Every class gets its own timer, starting at 60 minutes by default, with a Pause or Start button and a Reset, and a class is over notice when time runs out.
program:
app "Class timers Buddy" timer ink
table class name text, mins num 5..240 = 60
each class as c
  state left dur = c.mins * 1m
  state going bool = no
  every 1s if going set left = left - 1s
  when going and left <= 0s set going = no then notify c.name "class is over"
  row card gap 2
    draw width 40
      circle 50, 50, 40 fill if(going, good, soft)
    stack grow
      c.name bold
      left big
    button if(going, "Pause", "Start") tap set going = not going
    button "Reset" tap set going = no then set left = c.mins * 1m
form class, "Add class"

request: Monthly household budget with categories rent, groceries, school, transport, medicine and eid savings. Enter each expense with date and category. Show a bar for each category against its monthly limit, red when I go over. Name the app "Household Buddy".
program:
app "Household Buddy" home mint
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Groceries|School|Transport|Medicine|Eid_savings, note text?
setting lim_rent money = 30000 "Rent limit"
setting lim_groceries money = 20000 "Groceries limit"
setting lim_school money = 10000 "School limit"
setting lim_transport money = 5000 "Transport limit"
setting lim_medicine money = 3000 "Medicine limit"
setting lim_eid money = 5000 "Eid savings limit"
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Spent this month" sum(expense.amount month of m) big
each options expense.category as k
  let spent = sum(expense.amount month of m where category = k)
  let lim = if(k = Rent, lim_rent, if(k = Groceries, lim_groceries, if(k = School, lim_school, if(k = Transport, lim_transport, if(k = Medicine, lim_medicine, lim_eid)))))
  stack gap 1
    row
      k bold grow color if(spent > lim, bad, ink)
      spent "of" lim
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / lim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > lim, bad, accent) radius 2
form expense
list expense month of m by day

request: For my family, a zakat box for cash, gold, silver, their rates and debts, showing the 2.5 percent due when I am above the nisab, plus a tip page for the bill, tip percent and people, with each person's share.
program:
app "Zakat and tip" calc slate
setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  "People" people faint
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big

request: need to see if i overspend on rent or groceries
program:
app "Household" home ocean
table expense what text, amount money, category pick Rent|Groceries|School|Transport|Medicine|Eid_savings, note text?
setting lim_rent money = 30000 "Rent limit"
setting lim_groceries money = 20000 "Groceries limit"
setting lim_school money = 10000 "School limit"
setting lim_transport money = 5000 "Transport limit"
setting lim_medicine money = 3000 "Medicine limit"
setting lim_eid money = 5000 "Eid savings limit"
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Spent this month" sum(expense.amount month of m) big
each options expense.category as k
  let spent = sum(expense.amount month of m where category = k)
  let lim = if(k = Rent, lim_rent, if(k = Groceries, lim_groceries, if(k = School, lim_school, if(k = Transport, lim_transport, if(k = Medicine, lim_medicine, lim_eid)))))
  stack gap 1
    row
      k bold grow color if(spent > lim, bad, ink)
      spent "of" lim
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / lim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(spent > lim, bad, accent) radius 2
form expense
list expense month of m by day

request: 5000 a month of savings, a 10 percent yearly return and 15 years, and the result shows after the years. Sliders let me change the return and years.
program:
app "Growth" chart mint
state pay money = 5000
state rate num = 10
state years num = 15
field pay "Saving each month"
"Yearly return %" rate faint
slider rate 0..30
"Years" years faint
slider years 1..30
let fv(y num) = if(rate = 0, pay * 12 * y, pay * (pow(1 + rate / 1200, 12 * y) - 1) / (rate / 1200))
"After" years "years" faint
(fv(years)) big
"You put in" (pay * 12 * years) faint
plot 0..years, 0..fv(years) axes
  each 1..years
    rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, fv(it) fill accent radius 2
    tick index + 0.5, it

request: budget left to spend this month
program:
app "Budget" wallet plum
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Travel|Fun|Health
setting budget money = 80000 "Monthly budget"
state m date = today
state cat text = ""
let spent = sum(spend.amount month of m)
monthnav m
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
"Safe to spend" round((budget - spent) / (monthdays(m) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day. Last month:" sum(spend.amount prev month) faint
draw 100, 50
  line 0, 50, 100, 0 stroke edge
  poly stroke accent thick 2
    each days month of m
      pt 100 * monthday(it) / monthdays(m), 50 - 50 * clamp(sum(spend.amount month of m where at <= it) / budget, 0, 1)
each spend month of m by category
  stack tap set cat = if(cat = it.key, "", it.key)
    row
      it.key grow
      sum(it.amount) bold
    draw 100, 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(it.amount) / spent, 3 fill if(cat = it.key, accent, muted)
form spend
list spend month of m where cat = "" or category = cat by day

request: a tic tac toe game for two players on one phone, i want to call it Daily Tic tac toe.
program:
app "Daily Tic tac toe" board ink
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: a tic tac toe game for two players on one phone. I want it green.
program:
app "Tic tac toe" board mint
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: can i see my study timetable and timer?
program:
app "Study" school mint
table subject name text
table lesson subject ref subject, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat = Mon, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied subject ref subject, mins num 1..
table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 25m "Focus length"
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

request: tic tac toe who wins or draw
program:
app "Tic tac toe" board mint
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: A weekly average of homework minutes for each child, with a picker to switch kids and red for overdue homework, in ocean colours.

app "Homework" pencil ocean
table child name text

choice kid

  row card gap 1 tap edit h

      h.subject bold color if(h.due < today and h.done = no, bad, ink)

app "Friends I owe" users mint
table friend name text, phone text?
table friend_entry friend ref friend, amount money, kind pick Gave|Got, due date?, note text?
"Net with friends" sum(friend_entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(friend_entry.amount where kind = Got) big
each friend as p
  let bal = sum(p.friend_entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(p.friend_entry.amount where kind = Got)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.friend_entry.at) faint
form friend, "Add friend"
form friend_entry, "Add entry"
list friend_entry by day

request: Keep the score of a kabaddi match. Include two big score boxes for Team 1 and Team 2 with plus 1 buttons, undo and a new game button, +2 and +3 buttons too, a history of every point, a winner message when someone reaches 40 and the lead between them.

      button "+3" tap add point team = Team_2, pts = 3
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Team 1 win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Team 2 win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point

app "Medicines" pill ink
table med name text, dose text?, per_day num 1..12 = 1, started date = today, stock num 0.. "Stock at start"
table taken med ref med
when count(med, floor((it.stock - count(it.taken)) / it.per_day) <= 5) > 0 notify "A medicine has 5 days or less left"
each med as m
  let left = m.stock - count(m.taken)
  let dleft = floor(left / m.per_day)
  stack card gap 1 tap edit m swipe remove m
    row gap 1
      stack grow
        m.name m.dose bold
        m.per_day "times a day since" m.started faint
      button "Took one" tap add taken med = m
    left "left," dleft "days" bold color if(dleft <= 5, bad, good)
form med, "Add medicine"

request: 23:00 bedtime and 7:00 wake-up, shown as arcs on a circle that I can change, with both times written beside it.
program:
app "Sleep Clock" bed ink
setting bed time = 23:00 "Bedtime"
setting wake time = 7:00 "Wake-up time"
let a = 360 * (((bed - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
let b = 360 * (((wake - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
draw width 220
  circle 50, 50, 46 stroke edge thick 1
  arc 50, 50, 38, a, if(b > a, b, b + 360) stroke accent thick 6
  label 50, 8, "12" tiny
  label 92, 52, "3" tiny
  label 50, 96, "6" tiny
  label 8, 52, "9" tiny
  label 50, 50, ((wake - bed) / 1h + 24) % 24 big
"Bedtime" bed "Wake-up" wake head

request: car loan calculator, price, down payment percent, years with a slider and yearly interest, shows monthly instalment, total paid and total interest
program:
app "Loan Calc" calc slate
state price num = 3000000
state down num = 20
state years num = 5
state yearly_rate num = 18
let loan = price * (100 - down) / 100
let r = yearly_rate / 1200
let n = years * 12
let emi = loan * r * pow(1 + r, n) / (pow(1 + r, n) - 1)
field price "Price"
field down "Down payment %"
slider years 1..10
field yearly_rate "Yearly rate %"
"Monthly instalment" round(emi) big
"Total paid" round(emi * n + price * down / 100) faint
"Interest paid" round(emi * n - loan) faint

let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center

request: A coloured scale shows where my number sits. It gives my healthy weight range in kilograms from my height. Weight and height are boxes I type into.
program:
app "BMI" scale mint
state kg num = 70
state cm num = 170
field kg "Weight (kg)"
field cm "Height (cm)"
let h = cm / 100
let bmi = round(kg / max(h * h, 0.01) * 10) / 10
bmi big
if(bmi < 18.5, "Underweight", if(bmi < 25, "Healthy", if(bmi < 30, "Overweight", "Obese"))) head
draw 100, 14
  rect 0, 4, 18.5 * 2.5, 6 fill blue
  rect 18.5 * 2.5, 4, 6.5 * 2.5, 6 fill good
  rect 25 * 2.5, 4, 5 * 2.5, 6 fill warn
  rect 30 * 2.5, 4, 100 - 75, 6 fill bad
  circle clamp(bmi, 10, 40) * 2.5 - 25, 7, 5 fill ink
"Healthy range for you:" round(18.5 * h * h * 10) / 10 "to" round(24.9 * h * h * 10) / 10 "kg" faint

"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1

    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)

request: tic tac toe for two players
program:
app "Daily Tic tac toe" board ink
table move game num, cell num 1..9, mark pick X|O
setting cur num = 1 "Game"
let n = count(move where game = cur)
let turn = if(n % 2 = 0, "X", "O")
let win(m text) = count([123, 456, 789, 147, 258, 369, 159, 357], count(move where game = cur and mark = m and (cell = floor(it / 100) or cell = floor(it / 10) % 10 or cell = it % 10)) = 3) > 0
let xw = win("X")
let ow = win("O")
if xw or ow
  if(xw, "X", "O") "wins!" big
else
  if(n = 9, "Draw", turn) if(n = 9, "", "to play") big
grid 3 gap 1
  each 1..9 as c
    if count(move where game = cur and cell = c) = 0 and not xw and not ow
      box height 80 radius 8 fill soft tap add move game = cur, cell = c, mark = turn
    else
      box height 80 radius 8 fill surface
        last(move.mark where game = cur and cell = c) big align center
button "New game" tap set cur = cur + 1

request: Today's habits show as a progress bar of done out of total with an All done today message when I finish, plus my best streak in days for each habit.
program:
app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

request: A tiffin business ledger: daily orders by customer, meal type, price, delivery cost, and a weekly summary showing income, cost and profit, with the most profitable customer highlighted. Purple theme please.
program:
app "Tiffin" food plum
table customer name text
table order customer ref customer, meal pick Lunch|Dinner = Lunch, price money, delivery money = 0
row gap 2
  stat sum(order.price week), "income this week"
  stat sum(order.delivery week), "delivery cost"
  stat sum(order.price week) - sum(order.delivery week), "profit"
"Today's orders" head
each order today as o
  row card
    o.customer.name bold grow
    o.meal
    o.price
"Customers this week" head
each customer as c
  let pr = sum(c.order.price week) - sum(c.order.delivery week)
  row card gap 1 fill if(pr > 0 and pr = max(customer, sum(it.order.price week) - sum(it.order.delivery week)), good, surface)
    c.name bold grow
    count(c.order week) "orders"
    pr bold
    button "+ Lunch" tap add order customer = c, meal = Lunch, price = last(c.order.price)
form customer, "Add customer"
form order, "Add order"

request: A running low count in colour at the top, search by name, and each item with minus and plus buttons and its unit, turning red when at or below its low level.
program:
app "Pantry" box slate
table stock name text, qty num 0..1000, low num 0..1000 = 2, unit text = "pcs"
state q text = ""
let lowc = count(stock, it.qty <= it.low)
"Running low" lowc big color if(lowc > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each stock where has(name, q) sort name as s
  row card gap 1 tap edit s
    stack grow
      s.name bold
      s.qty s.unit color if(s.qty <= s.low, bad, muted)

form stock, "Add item"

request: Could the Wishlist app switch to the ocean theme? The bright colours are upsetting when I look at what I want to buy, and the list itself can stay the same.
program_before:
app "Wishlist" gift slate
table wish title text, done bool, tag pick Tech|Home|Clothes|Fun = Tech, priority pick Low|Normal|High = Normal
count(wish where done = no) "open" head
each wish where done = no sort priority desc as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.tag faint
form wish
"Done" faint
list wish where done = yes
remind "Check your wish list" at 8:00

request: The page of my books with a colour for each spine, Blue, Green, Orange, Red or Grey, plus pages and rating, and notes. A form adds each new book.
program:
app "My Bookshelf" book plum
table book title text, pages num 20..2000 = 200, colour pick Blue|Green|Orange|Red|Grey = Blue, rating num 1..5, notes long?
state sel text = ""
scroll
  each book sort title
    box width 36 height 100 radius 3 fill if(it.colour = Blue, accent, if(it.colour = Green, good, if(it.colour = Orange, warn, if(it.colour = Red, bad, muted)))) tap set sel = it.title
      it.title tiny color bg
each book where title = sel
  stack card gap 1
    it.title head
    "Rating" it.rating "of 5" bold
    it.notes
    button "Edit" tap edit it
form book, "Add book"
